title: benjaminia minor
intro:
Benjaminia minor, commonly known as Benjaminia, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Benjaminia minor include its use as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic agent, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Benjaminia minor include sesquiterpene lactones, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
